svg.title: Around a meeting: a brief, a card to join and record, reminders, a draft and a weekly review
svg.desc: Thursday, 9:50: ten minutes before Design review on the calendar, a panel shows a brief from the last notes about it: what was decided, what you said you'd do and what someone owes you. At 9:58 a card says the meeting starts in 2 minutes and offers to join it on Zoom and record it; Join opens the call, and Record starts a note named from the calendar. At 10:45 the meeting ends: the AI turns its to-dos into reminders and writes a follow-up email that waits as a draft for you to send. On Friday at 4:00 PM, the week's notes become a weekly review: what was decided, what you said you'd do, and what is still open.

g.text: Last time, you decided to ship the beta on the 17th.
You said you'd send Dana the numbers.
Dana owes you the new mockups.
Design review · with Priya Shah, Dana Ortiz
It's on Zoom. Record it into your notes?
Hi Dana and Priya, thanks for today. The beta
Ten minutes before a meeting, a brief from your last notes about it…
…as it starts, a card to join the call and record it…
…when it ends, your to-dos are reminders and the follow-up is a draft…
…and on Friday, the week's notes become a review.
